cards.subject: Brightwood
lines: When Medivh died, the fel in him went into the ground.
The forest has not seen the sun since.

cards.subject: Raven Hill
lines: The finest embalmers in Azeroth trained here.
Then the dead they had prepared got up.
Two residents left. The catacombs are still open.

seed.body: The catacombs under the cemetery go further down than they look. Bring a friend.

cards.subject: Morbent Fel
lines: Every corpse in this zone answers to him.
The chain to reach him starts at Sven's campfire.

cards.subject: Mor'Ladim
lines: An aggro radius bigger than anything else at this level.
Every Alliance player has a story about him.
Most of them end at the graveyard.

cards.subject: Morgan Ladimore
lines: A knight of Uther's, home too late to save his family.
The sword he swung at the gravestones was Archeus.
When he finally falls: "I need it no longer."

cards.subject: Abercrombie
lines: The comb. The juice. The rot blossoms.
His errands are a recipe.
The recipe is Stitches.

cards.subject: Stitches
lines: Two Night Watch stands are in his way.
Without help, he kills both.

seed.body: If the road goes quiet, leave the road. You get one scream of warning, zone-wide, and then nothing.

cards.subject: Twilight Grove
cards.tag: A door into the Emerald Dream
lines: A moonwell walled in by hills, with no marked way in.
Fandral Staghelm planted the tree from a branch of Nordrassil.

seed.body: Nothing in the grove wants you dead. Only place in the zone. Stand at the moonwell a while.

cards.subject: Roland's Doom
cards.tag: The mine east of the Rotting Orchard
lines: The worgen came out of this mine.
A priestess carried the Scythe of Elune in, and died holding it.
Jitters saw what followed. He is still shaking.

cards.subject: Stalvan Mistmantle
cards.tag: The Legend of Stalvan · thirteen quests
pages: A tutor came to Grand Hamlet,
The pages of his story are scattered

cards.subject: The six
lines: Each holds a fixed haunt.
Press a diamond.

rares.name: Lupos
lines: A wolf whose bite was shadow, not tooth.
Hunters walked here at 23 to tame it, until patch 1.9.

rares.name: Commander Felstrom
lines: Brought low, he kills himself and stands back up whole.
Beat him before he can die.

rares.name: Lord Malathrom
lines: A ghoul of the Dawning Woods Catacombs.
Mid-fight he raises two minions, Sloth and Sludge.

rares.name: Fenros
lines: Alone between the Nightbane camps.
The axe says lumberjack, from before the turning.

rares.name: Nefaru
lines: The Den Mother, deep in Roland's Doom.
The pack answers to her.

rares.name: Naraxis
lines: A great spider in a web-choked cave.
No tamable spider wears her colour outside Zul'Gurub.
